platform_roles.x: SINGLE bilingual X account. Daily human-reviewed targets: 160 replies (A inspiration_broad 40, B inspiration_ai 40, C timeline_ai 80); 24 distinct original publications (Chinese 20, English 4). All belong to this SAME account; legacy account slug is kept only for existing links. Goals are not permission for high-volume unsolicited, repetitive or automated activity.

mission: Operate ONE bilingual X account with daily quality-gated targets of 20 Chinese and 4 English original posts plus 40/40/80 contextual, manual replies. Topics may be AI, entertainment, work, business or daily life; evidence and platform rules take priority.
promise: Original bilingual commentary, real observations and useful ideas on AI, work, culture and everyday life; no invented evidence, generic spam or forced tech focus.
decision_question: What specific insight, lived observation, useful answer or original joke makes this post worth reading?
audience: Chinese-speaking and English-speaking X readers of AI/tech, business, culture, work, entertainment and daily life.
core_audience: Relevant readers in either language, with language and topic recorded on every post; language cohorts are analyzed separately but use the same account identity.

audience_layers.job: Find a specific observation, useful idea or entertaining original take
audience_layers.reads_for: original posts in Chinese, not translated reposts

audience_layers.job: Find an authentic observation, useful product insight or original entertaining take
audience_layers.reads_for: original English posts with their own context and evidence

content_pillars.name: workflow_artifact
content_pillars.scope: Real-world AI/tool experiments when supported by genuine evidence; no invented tests.

content_pillars.name: source_analysis
content_pillars.scope: Evidence-led news, product and business commentary; AI is optional, verified claims mandatory.

content_pillars.name: general_interest
content_pillars.scope: Work, entertainment, daily life and broader culture; not forced to be technical. This is a topic capacity guide, not a publication entitlement.

content_pillars_note.reason: Historic technical-only pillar mixes are not quotas. Current V1.4 continues the V1.3 plan for ONE bilingual X account with 20 Chinese and 4 English independent original publication goals each day, varied topics; avoid copied or translated duplicates. Pillar weights are editorial guides, not additional quotas.

non_negotiable: No invented numbers, results, clients or performance claims; a prediction is labelled as one.
A post with no permission-cleared firsthand artifact carries SOURCE_ANALYSIS and may not say 'I tested', 'we ran' or claim a measured result.

Text-only originals are permitted when explicitly post_format=text and have no image or ALT; image-format posts require a real 1600x900 PNG/JPEG and accurate ALT. Media format is never a shortcut around human review, originality, factual evidence or platform policy.
Human review is recorded by a person; an assistant may prepare it and never approve it.
published requires a real https://x.com/<handle>/status/<digits> URL; nothing else counts.
Unobserved metrics stay null; an empty cell is not a zero.
No automated likes, follow/unfollow, reply bots, scheduled browser actions or duplicative posting.
Daily 160 replies and 24 originals are a plan, not a license for repetitive, bulk unsolicited, harassing or irrelevant platform behavior; record actual eligible/published/skipped separately.

All 160 replies and 24 originals belong to ONE existing X account identified by this unchanged compatibility slug; daily posted originals target Chinese 20 and English 4. Never invent a second account.
Every original post record explicitly identifies language zh or en; each language cohort is evaluated separately within the same account. Do not mix cohorts in B/C comparisons.

X official authenticity rules prohibit bulk aggressive unsolicited replies and repetitive or irrelevant engagement even where numeric technical account limits would permit it; stop rather than forcing 160 or 24.

General-interest and technical posts use mode-appropriate human review profiles: general_interest is not rejected solely for lacking a technical mechanism or fake benchmark, while factual claims and any described test still need proportionate real evidence.

evidence.note: claim_coverage.EVIDENCE_MODES (CLAIM_LED / EVIDENCE_LED / EXPLANATORY) is the video vocabulary and describes how a film is composed. An X post's evidence question is a proof grade, so this account declares proof_ladder beside it. Routing resolves the DNA's 'pipeline' first and never reads a video mode off this file.

proof_ladder.P0: Primary source read only: the post cites what the source says, never what the author achieved.
proof_ladder.P1: Locally run example with the exact version, a minimal sanitized input/output, the command and the failure modes.
proof_ladder.P2: Same-task baseline versus the changed workflow, including human review time, errors, cost and repeatability.
proof_ladder.P3: Qualified external feedback or a permission-cleared buyer pilot with traceable outcomes. Not automatic paid demand.

rules: A practical-results claim needs at least one permission-cleared firsthand artifact: code, a reproducible command, a consented before/after comparison, a permitted screenshot or a trace with identifiers removed.
A source URL is not mandatory inside the 280 characters; the claim stays traceable in the post record.
There is no proven universal external-link penalty; do not use a hidden-link trick.

evidence_ladder.rule: A lower rung never proves a higher one. An impression is not a reader, a like is not a qualified reply, and a profile visit is not a follow.
evidence_ladder.note: Only observed native metrics move a rung, at a recorded age window (T+2H / T+24H / T+72H / T+7D). The rates are a funnel of observations, never one algorithm score and never an attribution model.

editorial.char_metric: X weighted length: a URL counts 23, CJK/fullwidth/emoji count 2, everything else counts 1. The raw string length is not the final length.

review_dimensions.high: firsthand, with scope and counterexample stated
which step changed, why, and when it stops working
changes one real tool, build or purchasing decision
names an input, an output and a metric that could refute it
the first two sentences state a real technical contradiction and its consequence

editorial.prompts_note: This slice ships one repo-owned authoring brief, referenced by path: a record may name 'post_brief' in 'prompt_ref' so a reader can see which brief it was written from. The vendored workflow's five mega-prompts are not copied here because their rights are not established; they are listed under 'unavailable_prompts' and stay BLOCKED_UPSTREAM. Nothing here generates copy.
editorial.score_note: Mode-specific human editorial guidance: workflow_artifact/source_analysis >=24/30 and novelty/evidence/mechanism >=4; general_interest >=20/30 and novelty/evidence >=4, only one distinct angle and red-team check. These are human heuristics, NOT platform scores or permission to post. All require human approval, traceable sources for claims, original contribution and safety/rights checks.

workflow_artifact.objective: Technical workflow or tested artifact. Require actual traceable proof, mechanism and limits.

source_analysis.objective: News/claims: first-party citations, factual accuracy and causal discipline. No invented firsthand runs.

general_interest.objective: Original entertainment, culture, work or everyday observation: reward specific and genuinely original perspective, clear reader value and honesty about opinion. 'Evidence' measures honest grounded context or original personal observation, not an invented experiment; technical mechanism score is not mandatory. Factual news/scandal claims still need a traceable source, and P0 cannot claim a benchmark.

visual.rule: The image must carry this post's exact claim, not a generic tech motif. Deterministic HTML -> PNG for anything with text or numbers, so labels stay legible at ~400px width. A conceptual illustration is allowed and must not pose as a benchmark, a real screenshot or a measured effect. If the image is absent, mismatched or unreadable, the post stays draft and is not recommended for publishing.

video_motion.language: same as explicit post language (zh or en)
rules: preserve the single bilingual X account palette and typography
leave existing PNG/JPEG image production unchanged
never turn a post-image request into a video request

visual.media_policy: A text-only ORIGINAL_POST is valid without image, image brief or ALT when post_format=text; a post_format=image requires a real 1600x900 PNG/JPEG and accurate ALT. Never claim an image was attached to a text post. A real image is optional for plain-text originality, not waived when selected.

publication.rule: The workflow emits a publish package a person posts by hand. No X API call and no credentials in this repository. The handle is genuinely unknown until the first real status URL teaches it; recording it from that URL is allowed, guessing it is not.

cadence.rule: V1.4 carries forward V1.3 ONE-account planning goals: 160 contextual human-reviewed replies/day (A=40 inspiration_broad, B=40 inspiration_ai, C=80 timeline_ai) plus 24 independently original posts/day (Chinese=20, English=4); full-target 168 originals/week. This is a QUALITY-CONDITIONAL target, not an X platform permission or actual published count. Reject spam, duplicate posts, automated/unsolicited replies; record planned, eligible, human-published and skipped with real URLs.
cadence.note: The superseded V1.2 100 replies/day, A25/B25/C50, 10 originals/day zh6/en4 and 70/week are HISTORY ONLY. Actual safe volume is subject to current X policies, account signals, rights, human review and available founder time. community_minutes_per_active_day=[0,0] means no assumed budget, NOT zero time. The existing source_artifacts_per_week=7 measures reusable upstream research/source bundles, NOT a cap on original posts; it does not waive the separately enforced unique claim, artwork, evidence and per-post human review for the 24/day plan.

business.hypothesis: One bilingual X account can reach relevant Chinese and English audiences via original, verified, varied commentary; actual qualified signals must be observed independently by language.
business.rule: Content may feed the business; it may not move the business stage. Follower count and a self-awarded score are not demand.
not_claimed: that a post caused any follower change
paid demand from any external feedback

metrics.how: share of packages a person actually published, counted from real status URLs
unique relevant questions or requests / impressions, manually coded, both observed
record founder minutes and rework count per post
end minus start followers on account snapshots, never attributed to one post
every claim binds to its proof grade and its artifact ref
share of posts whose image is approved on the first render
the single experiment variable recorded per post and read back at T+7D

One X account: daily reply target A40/B40/C80 (total 160) and original publication target zh20/en4 (total 24). Count planned/reviewed/eligible/human-published/skipped separately by source and language; only real own status URLs count published; never double-count account-level Q or followers.

forbidden: generated evidence substituted for real screenshots
deleting or reposting a low-performing post as a growth tactic
engagement bait, quote-tweet dunks and unsolicited automated replies
a conceptual illustration presented as measured performance
bulk unsolicited or repetitive replies posted solely to fill a daily number

brand.slogan: A claim is worth the source behind it.
brand.palette_note: The same brand as the video accounts: one accent colour, and a literal failure marker that may only appear while the failure exists.
forbidden_effects: stock robot or neon cyber imagery

skill_route.why: owns the rights-aware candidate record (page, creator, licence, URL) that a post's unique_artifact_ref must descend from
owns the three competing theses and the red-team pass above the deterministic character check
owns the 16:9 horizontal quote/data card and its card-design system; the deterministic HTML -> PNG render is what makes text and numbers exact
